authorization: User WL56 brief: Exact Selective K Recompute and Dynamic Update Cost Headroom; current Selective_Recompute only, no branches/worktrees; no learned representation
status: Fixed before any WL56 numerical result. Debug/smoke observations will be disclosed separately. All future changes appended as amendments.
scope: Physical TR oracle domain-level skip baseline. CAK not adopted. WL53-55 and production files unchanged.
source_choice: Unit-radiance one-sided Lambertian emitter rather than a collimated sun: every direct and indirect input goes through the arm's K. Using WL55 exact-current run_sun in the stale arm would leak current intrinsic transport into that control. This is a declared source choice, not a change to physical material or reference settings.

fixture.medium: WL53 homogeneous index-matched isotropic; sigma_t=1000/m; albedo=(.999,.99,.9)
fixture.rest: 10x10x1 cm slabs, centres z=-9/+9 mm, gap 8 mm
fixture.dent: upper top: WL53 map_dent, 5 mm depth, 20 mm radius, centre (0,0), bottom fixed; lower unchanged
fixture.rigid: upper translation (+3.7,-2.1,+2) mm, no intrinsic invalidation
fixture.source: down-facing absorbing emitter, 20x20 cm at z=54 mm, 2.5 mm tessellation; L=1; no sun
fixture.diagnostic_camera: otop is reported, never a strict primary 3% test

representation.semantics: flux per cell/bin; complete T plus camera NEE KC, current-geometry ballistic KB; no intra-domain approximation; every medium K entry->first air exit; C every air segment incl same-domain re-entry
representation.historical_operator_cache: WL55 slab_L4_s1/s2; KC restricted to the declared three cameras. Existing original files never modified.

illumination: 64M source rays per geometry and replicate; 8M chunks; exact intersections -> current input flux; regenerated identically inside timed F/S/T update, not target images; field is shared only in shared-operator correctness diagnostic

arms.F: Actually rebuild both complete domain T/KC packages on primary dent scene each seed; current C, current incident field, global solve, current KB
arms.S: Actually rebuild dirty upper domain, preserve cached lower package identity; same geometry/C/field seeds, global solve
arms.T: Both rest packages, current C/field and current KB; stale KC converted to current-geometry bin readout at the deformed upper domain; no fresh current intrinsic response
arms.rigid: F actual rebuild of both domains one seed; S and T reuse both rest packages; shared-sample and independent-seed diagnostics
arms.independent: Compose F dirty current with the other cached clean-domain seed to isolate unchanged-domain MC noise; compare to S and the two-seed noise; no extra fitted state

primary_groups: Both WL53 interior masks (>=30 pixels) and WL54 centre-ray masks (>=30 pixels and >=90% projected coverage). Primary amended face-on cameras top/gapdown/gapup/bot. Every face/domain/channel with >=5 ports and >=2% selected camera signal is ruled. Also fixed lower:top disc of rest port centres radius<=25 mm in gapdown (localized stationary receiver); report both full-face and disc, never select post hoc.

criteria.shared_operator_equality: relative L1 flux and per-port radiance <=1e-6, numerical max normalized <=1e-5; deterministic same-sample reconstruction checked separately; identity of reused lower package must hold
criteria.physical_accuracy: historical |sum(pred-ref)/sum(ref)| <=.03 + 3*SE on every ruled primary group/channel, amended mask. Original masks and oblique groups always reported; neither favorable averages nor equality prove physical accuracy
criteria.uncertainty: Reference SE from independent seed GROUP statistics (not pixel/port independence). K SE from two independent full package seeds: abs(group1-group2)/2. Combine quadratically. Report mean +/-3SE intervals as descriptive uncertainty, not guaranteed 95% CI with 2 K seeds.
criteria.detectability: On stationary lower top full-face OR the fixed disc, dent-rest reference relative L2 signal >3 times independent paired seed noise AND pooled absolute signed change >max(.002,3*SE_delta). If reference does not resolve this, mark low-impact/inconclusive and stop before expensive new full builds. Geometry/source never enlarged to force a signal.
criteria.reference_escalation: Only if initial 4x1024 spp cannot resolve the preregistered edit gate, one 4x4096 spp rerender at identical settings/geometry is permitted; preserve the first run, no parameter tuning
criteria.independent_F_S: Group difference within 3 times measured combined K-seed SE plus 1e-4 reference signal; report all exceptions
criteria.stationary_recovery: F/S equality plus nonzero reference change gate; physical signed change slope .9-1.1 and corr>=.9 on selected receiver ports, unless variance makes regression ill-conditioned (then inconclusive). Stale loss only when |B_T|-|B_S| >3*SE_delta; low impact is valid
criteria.efficiency: Primary dent: S measured warm end-to-end median <=.75 F; shared non-K costs independently measured. Report K dominated oracle scope. Rigid: no K rebuild for S, no mandatory speedup threshold
criteria.stability: Unchanged WL53 solve tol=1e-7, max_iter=2000; A^2 rho<1; closure C+escape=1 within1e-6; intrinsic nonnegative and max colsum<=1+1e-6; leak/wrong-side rate<=1e-5

cost.primary: Two independent seeds, one actual F and one actual S rebuild per seed, ordered F1,S1,S2,F2 to expose drift; actual execution log, no inferred multiplication
cost.rigid: one actual F rebuild both domains, S reuse; replay solve/cache-only timings 3 times, distinct from costly TR replication
cost.persistent: raw T/KC file bytes plus per-domain logical and unique physical cache bytes; same-shaped domains can physically deduplicate but full baseline explicitly rebuilds both
cost.scaling: Only N=2, dirty=1 and dirty=0 measured; analytic N={2,4,8}, d={0,1,N} projections clearly labelled, no large constructed scene
cost.break_even: Use measured shared cost H plus selection/cache overhead O. Sweep hypothetical intrinsic rebuild k analytically (.001,.01,.1,1,10,100 seconds/domain). Meaningful saving defined as>=20% end-to-end; derive k threshold from (Nk+H_F)/(dk+H_S)>=1.25; no neural or TransGI speed claim
cost.cache_residency_note: Primary F/S updates include checkpoint persistence, CPU/page-cache package access, hash checks and CSR transfers independently measured. Additional rigid S updates (3) reuse actual GPU CSR K after measured initialization and re-run all boundary/C/source/solve/readout work; no TR and no hypothetical dent timing substitution.

tests: Focused small block shared F/S construction, cache signatures, rigid vs dent invalidation, source field linearity and zero, K/C closure/ownership, passivity, fixed point residual, current C update, ballistic readout, deterministic masks; relevant WL53/WL54/WL55 regressions with skipped checks explicitly counted
resource: LabServer69 RTX3090; scratch/output exclusively ~/rest_wl56; no deletion or infrastructure changes. GPU workloads sequential except CUDA reference may run while CPU-only audit. Resource bounded by declared number of full operators and scenes, no sweeps.

amendments.fact: First focused test run: 5/6 passed; flipping emitter triangle corner order breaks CASP port-grid reconstruction and produces degenerate subdivided emitter triangles. Fixed orientation by reflecting the open_grid parameter geometry in y, keeping triangle ordering. Physical source extent/position/emission unchanged, no threshold changed. Original failed results preserved as focused_v1.json/preflight_v1.log.

Blender does not add the script directory to sys.path. Reference wrapper initially exited with ModuleNotFoundError and no images; added explicit path and --python-exit-code 1. All 25 performed regression checks passed; WL54 mask check skipped due historical file naming, recorded separately. No references/results existed when fixed.

Reference wrapper must set inherited p53_cycles.OUT/LOG as its original main does. First real render attempt failed before any image with OUT=None; fixed initialization, retain reference_v1.log. No reference settings or geometry changed.

readout_comparison: F/S physical primary = current KC + KB. For stale loss, compare F/S/T using the identical current-frame outgoing-bin readout (includes unscattered transport), and report its bias against the renderer separately. Stale rest KC on the dented upper top is diagnostic only, never a valid precise camera response.
